Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the candid conversation. Below is a quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving.

Summary of pain points & goals
- You need SOC 2 Type II evidence and pen test summary to satisfy vendor risk review.
- Audit log retention and ability to export raw logs (redacted/pseudonymized) is a must — legal asked about 7-year retention as a potential requirement.
- DPA and standard security controls (KMS, encryption at rest/in transit, access logs) need to be reviewed and signed.

What we will provide (next 48-72h)
- SOC 2 report (latest) and pen test summary (redacted) — attaching copies.
- DPA draft for your review via DocuSign link (or we can accept redlines).
- Notes on audit log export options and retention settings (short summary below).

Audit logs / retention (high-level)
- Hosted Redwood API: default retention 90 days for raw request logs; aggregated telemetry available longer.
- Dedicated/Private: configurable retention; for Private we can support extended retention (up to 7 years) via customer-managed S3 storage or on-prem retention policies.
- Exports: logs export to S3/Cloud Storage or syslog endpoint; we can support pseudonymization before export.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) I'll send SOC 2 + pen test summary and DPA draft (attached).
2) Marissa (SE) will follow up with the log export/config details and steps to enable longer retention for Dedicated/Private.
3) Please confirm if Acme needs evidence in a specific format (CSV, JSON, Splunk/ELK ingest files).
4) Proposed follow-up: 30-min call with your security reviewers week of Apr 26 — pick two windows and we'll lock one.

Hi Alex — happy to follow up with the technical details from the SE side. Thanks Neha for the summary.

Answers to your questions:
- Retention & exports:
  - Hosted (multi-tenant): default raw request logs retained 90 days. We provide aggregated usage and per-token billing data for longer windows.
  - Dedicated: retention configurable - we can extend to 1-3 years depending on plan and storage configuration.
  - Private (VPC / on-prem): customer-managed retention - we can configure retention up to 7 years using your S3 or on-prem archive.
  - Export options: logs can be exported as JSON or newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) to an S3 bucket, or streamed to your syslog/ELK endpoint. We can also provide Splunk HEC-compatible export.
  - Redaction/pseudonymization: we support server-side filters to remove or hash specific fields (email, user_id) before export. This can be automated at export time or applied on ingest.

- Pen test / SOC 2 evidence:
  - I've attached the redacted SOC2_report_2026.pdf and PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf (high-level remediation timeline included). The pen test file lists CVE references where relevant; full vulnerability details are available under NDA if you need them.

- DPA / legal:
  - Neha will share the DPA via DocuSign; we can accept tracked redlines or a marked-up Word doc.

Next steps (SE action items)
1) I'll share a short runbook (Drive link) showing how to configure exports and retention for Dedicated/Private and how to enable pseudonymization filters.
2) If you want, we can spin up a 7-day Dedicated evaluation with extended retention enabled for Acme to validate export and ingestion flows.
3) Schedule 30-min session with your security team during week of Apr 26 — suggested slots: Tue 4/27 09:00-09:30 PT or Wed 4/28 11:00-11:30 PT.

Attachments: SOC2_report_2026.pdf (redacted stub); PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf (redacted stub)

Hi Alex — quick note from security engineering.

- Encryption & key management:
  - Data encrypted at rest using AES-256; keys are managed in a customer-tied KMS for Dedicated/Private deployments. We also offer HSM-backed keys for FIPS workloads.
  - All network traffic uses TLS 1.3.

- Audit logs & access logs:
  - Access logs (who accessed what) are separate from request payload logs; both can be exported.
  - For Private deployments, customers have full control of key rotation and log retention policies.

- Evidence / pen test details:
  - The pen test summary provided is intentionally redacted for public distribution. For full evidence (raw findings, PoCs), we will require an NDA and an evidence transfer agreement; we can set up a secure SharePoint/Drive share under NDA.

I attached a baseline DPA_draft.docx for your legal team to review. If Acme has a standard vendor security questionnaire (e.g., SIG, CAIQ), send it over and we'll route to the right owners.

Thanks,
